Activate the version that was active before the current one, or --to N. A version
once approved needs no fresh approval to go back to. Like activate, it shows what
changes and waits for y unless --yes.

Usage:
  andara-cli content rollback <pack> [flags]

Flags:
      --as string   run as this account ID (operator or game master; every call is audited)
  -h, --help        help for rollback
      --to uint     the version to go back to (default: the one active before this)
      --yes         don't ask for confirmation

Global Flags:
      --config string            config file path (default $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/andara/cli.yaml)
      --credentials string       credential file path (default $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/andara/credentials.yaml)
      --log-level string         CLI diagnostic level (default "warn")
      --no-color                 disable ANSI output
  -o, --output string            output format: human or json (default "human")
      --server-address string    server endpoint (gRPC/Connect over TLS) (default "localhost:8443")
      --timeout duration         per-command deadline (default 30s)
      --tls-ca string            CA bundle to trust (empty uses the system trust store)
      --tls-server-name string   verify the server's certificate against this name, not the dialed host (a port-forward)
